title: Apply all six incident-specific Anomaly consequences
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Apply the actual current incident consequence without moving tracks: I01 next-round10-second reduction; I02 visual vote-card scramble descriptor without changing authoritative seats/totals; I03 one public event-feed line redacted without exposing hidden data; I04 next-round Jam of one active player; I05 temporary route-obscured presentation state; I06 suppress the next last-ten-second audio warning once. Persist explicit effect state and semantic events for UI/audio adapters. Use existing Jam/Safeguard rules. D-I04-JAM-TARGET must specify who/how chooses the I04 active target; D-TIMER-COMPOSITION applies to I01. Do not invent different cards or randomly choose a Repair/Sabotage result.
acceptance: Each I01–I06 Anomaly applies exactly its specified effect while both track counts stay unchanged.
One-round/one-warning/temporary modifiers expire or consume exactly once and cannot alter canonical seat order or reveal secrets.
I04 target/protection and combined timer behavior use recorded design decisions rather than an undocumented worker fallback.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
